summary: viper-1.4 mobile milestone: videogen mobile writes one phone-first Run-all notebook (clips+voice+foley+upscale, prompts baked in, per-stage toggles, DONE/ADHURA gate); which() falls back to the imageio-ffmpeg static binary and probe() parses 'ffmpeg -i' so mix/verify/assemble run in the sandbox; three real bugs found and fixed by an end-to-end sandbox run (asplit ducker for the single-consumption ffmpeg rule, loudnorm moved inside the graph, verify now rejects 0-byte files); docs/MOBILE.md + AGENTS mobile protocol pin that the owner never types commands; 142 tests OK, validate 25/0, Drive synced to 19 files.
